mcq_fix.s: Which Act first introduced direct elections in India?
mcq_fix.why: meta wording ('if an examination question asks...most appropriate') is not exam style

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: standard texts hold A true (government stayed centralised and unitary under the 1919 Act); key says A false

patterns: APPSC asks single facts: PSC provided by Section 96(C) of the 1919 Act; Simon Commission arrived in 1928; Prakasam led the Madras anti-Simon procession in 1928.
Dyarchy is the core concept: division of provincial subjects into reserved/transferred (reserved = justice, land revenue, police), introduced in the provinces by the 1919 Act.
Simon Commission questions recur in many shapes: why boycotted (no Indian member), Lajpat Rai lathi charge, recommendations (replace dyarchy with responsible government).
Traps: direct elections (1919, but an APPSC GS 2018 key gave 1909), Gandhi-Irwin Pact 1931 not 1930, Moderates formed the Liberal Federation.
App MCQs extend into the 1935 Act, Nehru Report and Madras ministries; depth is reasonable though some items lean to section numbers and sizes.
